text:
maria: Heads-up — EU midnight slice change window starts 00:30 UTC. Freeze goes into effect at 00:15. Pinning rollout to v3.14.2 for the slice. Please ack and call out any blockers.
aj: Ack. I have canary traffic routed for 2% for the first 10m.
maria: Thanks. @deploy-bot will kick the canary after the freeze.
deploy-bot: [bot] schedule accepted — canary deploy scheduled at 00:30:30 UTC to eu-slice-3 (v3.14.2).
sam: Quick note — embeddings route has a recent perf regression on long seqs, canary will validate qps and p95.
leo: I've added a smoke test in the canary pipeline: `curl -sS https://internal-eu/health && ./smoke-check.sh`
ops-bot: Canary metrics streaming to #metrics in 30s. Alert threshold: p95 > 220ms or error-rate > 0.8%.
maria: If canary looks green we'll ramp to 30% at +10m, then 60% at +25m, then full at +40m. Manual hold allowed at any ramp.
aj: If we trip the p95 threshold, rollback lane is to pin back to v3.14.1 and drain canary. Rollback owner: @aj.
sam: How do we execute rollback quickly? command?
aj: Use this: `deploy-bot rollback --slice eu-slice-3 --to v3.14.1 --drain 300` — that'll start a rolling revert and drain KV caches.
sre-oncall: I'll watch infra metrics. If error-rate spikes > 1.5% across slice I'll mute ramps and escalate.
deploy-bot: [bot] canary started: instance count 6 -> 8, config v3.14.2, trace id 0x9af3.
leo: smoke checks passing locally. hitting /health 200, latency ~85ms.
ops-bot: Metric snapshot: canary p50 60ms, p95 170ms, errors 0.12% — within thresholds.
maria: Good. Ramp to 30% in 2m unless objections.
aj: No objections. Proceed.
deploy-bot: [bot] ramping to 30% (traffic shift). ETA 90s.
sam: Observability note — watch kv cache miss rate, last deploy caused coldstart spike.
leo: Adding a short warmup job: `python tools/warmup.py --slice eu-slice-3 --tokens 1000`
ops-bot: Warmup job queued.
sre-oncall: infra metrics steady. CPU 56%, GPU mem 68%.
maria: Holdpoint at +10m for manual signoff. If any regressions we revert immediately.
aj: Copy. Rollback command ready.
deploy-bot: [bot] ramp complete: 30% traffic.
ops-bot: Canary tracing: tail logs -> small spike in redis timeouts at t+3m (0.05% requests) — watching.
sam: Not a showstopper but keep an eye.
leo: If redis timeouts cross 0.2% we might want the revert.
maria: Agreed. Team, please post any anomalies here. Otherwise we proceed to +60% ramp at +25m. :thumbsup:
aj: FYI leaving a pinned note in the playbook: `rollback-owner: aj`, `rollback-cmd: deploy-bot rollback --slice eu-slice-3 --to v3.14.1 --drain 300`, `postmortem-contact: maria`
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll keep a watch on infra and be ready to flip the switch.
deploy-bot: [bot] note: if automated fallback triggers, will revert to most recent pinned stable (v3.14.1).
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll post the final launch readout after full ramp.
